messages.snippet: Dear Diane, We act for the buyer of Redwood House, 14 Aldersgate Street. Ahead of completion on 15 M
messages.subject: Redwood House — service charge reconciliation for completion
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Diane,

We act for the buyer of Redwood House, 14 Aldersgate Street. Ahead of completion on 15 May, please could you provide: (1) the certified service charge accounts to 31 Dec 2025; (2) an estimate of on-account service charge for the buyer's period (15 May–31 Dec 2026); and (3) confirmation of the void apportionment on the basement store. We'll need these to finalise the completion statement.

Kind regards,
Elena Marchetti

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
DX 134777 Bishopsgate | +44 (0)20 7946 0500
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Elena,

2025 certified accounts show total expenditure of £214,600, recovered in full bar a £7,200 void on the basement store. On-account for the buyer's period to 31 Dec is estimated at £7,480. No reserve/sinking fund. I'll send the certified accounts pack separately.

Best,
Diane Calderbank
Calderbank Vine
